method.holdout: deterministic 20% holdout by spatial_group; all records from one group remain together; AUC requires at least five held-out groups and at least two held-out groups containing each class
method.uncertainty: Deterministic 2,000-resample spatial-group bootstrap interval where at least 200 valid group resamples are available; still exploratory and not an accuracy claim.

evaluation_gate_reasons: requires at least 5 held-out spatial groups
held-out split must contain both positive and negative labels
positive labels must occur in at least 2 held-out spatial groups
negative labels must occur in at least 2 held-out spatial groups
moon.interpretation: Exploratory spatial-group holdout on reviewer-labelled candidates. AUC is withheld unless the held-out split contains at least five independent spatial groups and at least two groups supporting each class. This is not a universal accuracy estimate; assess label quality, group design and uncertainty before drawing conclusions.

held-out split must contain both positive and negative labels
positive labels must occur in at least 2 held-out spatial groups
negative labels must occur in at least 2 held-out spatial groups
mars.interpretation: Exploratory spatial-group holdout on reviewer-labelled candidates. AUC is withheld unless the held-out split contains at least five independent spatial groups and at least two groups supporting each class. This is not a universal accuracy estimate; assess label quality, group design and uncertainty before drawing conclusions.

limitations: Labels must be independently sourced and reviewed; the script does not create or infer labels.
AUC is withheld unless the held-out split has both classes, at least five held-out spatial groups and at least two spatial groups supporting each class.
Spatial groups must be defined before looking at scores and should separate neighbouring or geologically related candidates.
This evaluates terrain-screening scores against supplied labels only; it does not prove planetary process equivalence or field truth.
